name: Bubbling Muck
oracle_text: Until end of turn, whenever a player taps a Swamp for mana, that player adds an additional {B}.
flavor_text: The muck claims a hundred living things for each meager treasure it spews forth.

name: Cone of Flame
oracle_text: Cone of Flame deals 1 damage to any target, 2 damage to another target, and 3 damage to a third target.

name: Dash Hopes
oracle_text:
When you cast this spell, any player may pay 5 life. If a player does, counter Dash Hopes.
Counter target spell.
flavor_text:
"Focus an enemy's mind on what's already gone, and it's easier to take away more."
—Holux, stronghold racketeer

name: Day of Black Sun
oracle_text: Each creature with mana value X or less loses all abilities until end of turn. Destroy those creatures.
flavor_text: The solar eclipse robbed Firebenders of their ability to firebend, giving Team Avatar an eight-minute window to storm the capital and defeat the Fire Lord.

name: Double Major
oracle_text: Copy target creature spell you control, except it isn't legendary if the spell is legendary. (A copy of a creature spell becomes a token.)
flavor_text: "Now I can dedicate myself fully to zoetimancy and void theory!"

name: Empty City Ruse
oracle_text: Target opponent skips all combat phases of their next turn.
flavor_text: Out of time and options, Kongming was forced to bluff at Xicheng. He tricked an army of 150,000 Wei by leaving the city gates open and calmly playing the zither.

name: False Cure
oracle_text: Until end of turn, whenever a player gains life, that player loses 2 life for each 1 life they gained.
flavor_text:
"I do unto others as others have done unto me."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: False Peace
oracle_text: Target player skips all combat phases of their next turn.
flavor_text: Mutual consent is not required for war.

name: Fatal Fissure
oracle_text: Choose target creature. When that creature dies this turn, you earthbend 4. (Target land you control becomes a 0/0 creature with haste that's still a land. Put four +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies or is exiled, return it to the battlefield tapped.)
flavor_text: Long Feng normally used the Dai Li to silence dissidents, but he wasn't above taking a more direct approach.

name: Fire and Brimstone
oracle_text: Fire and Brimstone deals 4 damage to target player who attacked this turn and 4 damage to you.

name: Flay
oracle_text: Target player discards a card at random. Then that player discards another card at random unless they pay {1}.
flavor_text: The Keldons would never admit it, but Greel unsettles them, too.

name: High Tide
oracle_text: Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana, that player adds an additional {U}.
flavor_text:
"Close the walls! Retract the docks! The homarids are coming!"
—Benson, Argivian sentry

name: Incriminate
oracle_text: Choose two target creatures controlled by the same player. That player sacrifices one of them of their choice.
flavor_text:
"If I were you, I'd check that elf's coat. I saw him slipping something into his pocket just before you arrived."
—Krandal, freelance instigator

name: Meddle
oracle_text: If target spell has only one target and that target is a creature, change that spell's target to another creature.
flavor_text: Strength may win the fight, but style wins the crowd.

name: Noxious Vapors
oracle_text: Each player reveals their hand, chooses one card of each color from it, then discards all other nonland cards.
flavor_text: Urborg would just as soon steal your memories as your life.

name: Panther Pounce
oracle_text: Target player investigates. Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains flying until end of turn. Untap it. (To investigate, create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
flavor_text:
"Did you truly think you could run from me?"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

name: Parallel Evolution
oracle_text:
For each creature token on the battlefield, its controller creates a token that's a copy of that creature.
Flashback {4}{G}{G}{G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

name: Play with Fire
oracle_text: Play with Fire deals 2 damage to any target. If a player is dealt damage this way, scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
flavor_text: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

name: Quicken
oracle_text:
The next sorcery spell you cast this turn can be cast as though it had flash. (It can be cast any time you could cast an instant.)
Draw a card.
flavor_text: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.

name: Rebound
oracle_text: Change the target of target spell that targets only a player. The new target must be a player.
flavor_text: Insult, like an arrow, is beyond control once loosed.

name: Scheming Symmetry
oracle_text: Choose two target players. Each of them searches their library for a card, then shuffles and puts that card on top.
flavor_text:
"One for you, one for me. What could be more fair?"
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

name: Scout's Warning
oracle_text:
The next creature card you play this turn can be played as though it had flash.
Draw a card.
flavor_text: "There is no tactic I enjoy more than ambushing the ambushers."

name: Scrounge
oracle_text: Target opponent chooses an artifact card in their graveyard. Put that card onto the battlefield under your control.
flavor_text: When leonin settlers abandon their homes to the nim, items of value are often left behind.

name: Seismic Wave
oracle_text: Seismic Wave deals 2 damage to any target and 1 damage to each nonartifact creature target opponent controls.
flavor_text: "Step carefully, Imperial. Even the earth rises against you."

name: Self-Destruct
oracle_text: Target creature you control deals X damage to any other target and X damage to itself, where X is its power.
flavor_text:
"Hah! If I'd just left you in the lurch, I'd look like a jerk for all of history!"
—Gilgamesh

name: Singularity Rupture
oracle_text: Destroy all creatures, then any number of target players each mill half their library, rounded down.
flavor_text:
"Rejoice! For within sekhar, the final sacrifice, you will find passage to the Next Eternity."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin

name: Spectacular Pileup
oracle_text:
All creatures and Vehicles lose indestructible until end of turn, then destroy all creatures and Vehicles.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
flavor_text: The first four crashes were accidental. Then the Endriders joined the fun.

name: Spiritualize
oracle_text:
Until end of turn, whenever target creature deals damage, you gain that much life.
Draw a card.
flavor_text:
"There is purity in all things. Even hatred."
—Lieutenant Kirtar

name: Visions of Dread
oracle_text:
Target opponent puts a creature card of their choice from their graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Flashback {8}{B}{B}. This spell costs {X} less to cast this way, where X is the greatest mana value of a commander you own on the battlefield or in the command zone. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

name: Second Guess
oracle_text: Counter target spell that's the second spell cast this turn.
flavor_text:
"I see where you're going with that. I don't like it."
—Dierk, geistmage

name: Rivals' Duel
oracle_text: Choose two target creatures that share no creature types. Those creatures fight each other. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
flavor_text: They could agree on one thing only: one of them must die.
